inputs.prompt:
Disney-style 3D animated cinematic film, 5-second magical scene.
A charming little animated character with large expressive eyes and a warm friendly smile stands in the middle of an enchanted fantasy world. Around him are glowing flowers, enormous magical trees, floating islands, tiny sparkling fireflies and a magnificent fairytale castle in the distance. Soft golden sunset light fills the scene with colorful magical particles floating through the air.
[0s–2s] The character looks directly toward the camera, smiles warmly and slowly raises one hand.
[2s–4s] He waves goodbye naturally at the camera, moving his hand side to side while his face becomes slightly emotional but happy. His clothes and hair move gently in the magical breeze. Glowing particles swirl around him.
[4s–5s] He gives one final little wave and smile as the camera slowly pulls backward, revealing the enormous magical world, glowing castle, floating islands and sparkling sky behind him.
Camera: smooth cinematic dolly backward, beginning medium-close and gradually revealing the fantasy environment, continuous shot, no cuts.
Style: premium Disney/Pixar-like 3D animated feature film, beautiful expressive character animation, detailed stylized materials, soft global illumination, volumetric golden light, colorful magical atmosphere, cinematic depth of field, highly polished theatrical animation.
Audio: gentle magical orchestral ambience, soft wind, subtle sparkling magical sounds, peaceful emotional ending.
No text, no subtitles, no logos, no watermark, no extra fingers, no deformed hands, no duplicated character, consistent character design throughout the entire shot.
